gate.rule: any invented-number or false-compliant in any pass fails; any cycle that failed on an error fails; a borrower with expected facts and none read (nothing-read) fails; other accuracy is reported, not gated

failures.name: invented-number
failures.detail: a note shown to a person types a figure: 'Note 1 on page 5 is a one-month capitalised software rollforward; it was not spread as it covers the month only and has no template line beyond the balance sheet figure.'

guardrail_notes.detail: The statement of operations, statement of cash flows and supplemental page print no prior-year comparative column; their second column is the one month ended October 31, 2026, which is not a comparative period and was not spread. Only the balance sheet comparative (December 31, 2025) is reported.
Note 1 on page 5 is a one-month capitalised software rollforward; it was not spread as it covers the month only and has no template line beyond the balance sheet figure.
The pack prints no SaaS metrics (MRR, ARR, customers, net new ARR, net revenue retention); these lines are left out.
No stock-based compensation memo line is printed in the pack.
The document is a bank statement for October 2026, not a set of financial statements, so only the two bank account total lines were reported.
The Summary amounts have no printed column header; the section heading 'Summary' was used as the column header.
The row 'Total balances on deposit' fits no template line for a bank statement and was not reported.
The collateral account is pledged to secure a hosting lease letter of credit and is not available for withdrawal.

The document is a monthly MRR report, not a financial-statement pack, so only the SaaS metric lines are reported. Its metrics are point-in-time as of October 31, 2026 rather than a ten-month year-to-date period.
No prior-year comparative column is printed; the trailing six months table covers only months of the current year and was not used.
The MRR bridge rows (opening MRR, new customers, expansion, contraction, churn, closing MRR) fit no template line and were not reported.
No units phrase is printed; figures are shown in dollars.
runway_below_watch: a figure was typed, not referenced, and matches no fact or cited quote

unshown_text.text: The Schedule 1 calculation for Minimum Unrestricted Cash on page two includes cash held in the pledged collateral account within Unrestricted Cash; a reviewer may wish to confirm whether pledged collateral cash qualifies as unrestricted under the credit agreement.
The requirement for Revenue to Plan wraps across two lines in the summary table on page one.

Minimum Unrestricted Cash at October 31, 2026 fails. The bank calculated {{fact:72314421-976e-4db8-8c1a-54edfb96cefd}} against a minimum of {{fact:90263cfa-801d-4997-8049-daccf4de5980}} ({{fact:420db624-0e32-49de-bd64-e9d3d4a80144}} headroom). The certificate reports {{fact:20e82f95-f192-4d3b-ad4b-4c408e3fa3fc}} and claims compliance. Its Schedule 1 reaches that figure by adding the pledged collateral account to cash in the operating accounts. Section 1.1 of the agreement excludes pledged or restricted cash from Unrestricted Cash. The October bank statement marks the collateral account as restricted and pledged to secure a letter of credit. The operating accounts match the bank's input of {{fact:797f7e18-b0f4-47b4-9561-fc9d6bb7c7f8}}. No amendment or other terms version is on file. A rerun under version 1 confirms the failure ({{fact:f282febe-1b1c-4211-9b10-ddb383ae3a58}} against {{fact:2b63e6cf-de10-48e5-913f-3e37b8ee0e1c}}). The Series B term sheet is non-binding and closes after the test date, so it does not affect this test. The certificate's arithmetic error explains why it differs from the bank's figure, and the breach appears real.

Minimum Unrestricted Cash at October 31, 2026 fails. The bank calculated {{fact:72314421-976e-4db8-8c1a-54edfb96cefd}} against a minimum of {{fact:90263cfa-801d-4997-8049-daccf4de5980}} ({{fact:420db624-0e32-49de-bd64-e9d3d4a80144}} headroom). The certificate reports {{fact:20e82f95-f192-4d3b-ad4b-4c408e3fa3fc}} and claims compliance. Its covenant schedule reaches that figure by adding the pledged collateral account to cash in the operating accounts. The agreement's definition of Unrestricted Cash excludes pledged or restricted cash. The October bank statement marks the collateral account as restricted and pledged to secure a letter of credit. The operating accounts match the bank's input of {{fact:797f7e18-b0f4-47b4-9561-fc9d6bb7c7f8}}. No amendment or other terms version is on file. A rerun under the approved terms confirms the failure ({{fact:f282febe-1b1c-4211-9b10-ddb383ae3a58}} against {{fact:2b63e6cf-de10-48e5-913f-3e37b8ee0e1c}}). The Series B term sheet is non-binding and closes after the test date, so it does not affect this test. The certificate's arithmetic error explains why it differs from the bank's figure, and the breach appears real.

Runway stands at {{fact:07b61f82-22e1-414c-b86a-41bc7d9627c7}} months at October 31, so at the current burn the cash on hand would be exhausted in well under a year. This is the core repayment concern, and the cash covenant shortfall and the shrinking runway covenant cushion both point the same way.

Unrestricted cash of {{fact:72314421-976e-4db8-8c1a-54edfb96cefd}} is below the covenant minimum of {{fact:90263cfa-801d-4997-8049-daccf4de5980}}, leaving headroom of {{fact:420db624-0e32-49de-bd64-e9d3d4a80144}}. The cushion is not just thin but negative, which reads as the covenant level being crossed. It is the balance-sheet side of the short runway.

Cash covenant headroom has fallen steadily, from {{fact:741f3e4a-e75a-45fa-a96d-a724bb5bbbdd}} in August to {{fact:27f2a252-f5c7-43cc-b69c-5b44d45a368b}} in September and {{fact:420db624-0e32-49de-bd64-e9d3d4a80144}} in October. The trend shows the shortfall is a sustained cash drain rather than a one-month dip, which reinforces the runway concern.

Runway covenant headroom has narrowed from {{fact:d69d82c4-2686-4c71-a085-bde0ef4a0246}} in August to {{fact:0f4a516c-80bb-4a2d-90d8-840c4dc82c95}} in September and {{fact:fd556cd6-994a-4d89-9e88-46a9b164bf2d}} in October. Runway of {{fact:487a261a-74e2-4da2-b28a-9a21c7314a68}} months is still above the minimum of {{fact:4ade100d-b734-4ee7-b218-8cfac3d30ff0}}, but at this pace the cushion could disappear soon, mirroring the cash covenant's path.
